g.text: Low-Level Design (LLD): Execution Pipeline & Thread Flow
Detailed internal execution mechanics: Go ACID Concurrency Ledger vs. Python AI Multi-Agent ReAct Engine
A. Core Banking Engine: ACID Ledger & Concurrency Flow (bank-core)
HTTP Ingress, JWT Validation & Rate Limiter
Extracts sender claims (user_id, email, roles); rejects expired/tampered tokens with 401.
Validates body schemas, verifies 2FA OTP code, and builds immutable transfer domain model.
Atomic SQL Transaction & Pessimistic Row Locking
tx := db.Begin() | SELECT * FROM accounts WHERE id IN (?, ?) FOR UPDATE
Locks sender and recipient rows in PostgreSQL. Prevents race conditions and double spending.
Throws OverdraftError or CardFrozenError if invariants fail, triggering immediate tx.Rollback().
UPDATE accounts (sender -= $, recipient += $) | INSERT INTO ledger_entries
tx.Commit() -> Emits Kafka/Audit Event -> Releases PostgreSQL Row Locks
Ensures zero financial drift. Both balances and transaction audit log mutate atomically.
Client renders real-time receipt and triggers account balance re-fetch.
B. AI Copilot: ReAct Swarm & Private MCP Protocol (bank-ai)
Inspects prompt for jailbreaks & prompt injection. Redacts PAN and CVV tokens before LLM dispatch.
Returns sub-millisecond cached response if exact match; restores active multi-day application drafts.
Decomposes compound prompts into sequential steps. Allocates sub-agents from SubAgentRegistry.
Sub-Agent ReAct Loop & Cascading Fallback Queue
Executes Thought-Action-Observation cycle. Automatically cascades across 7 models on rate limits.
Safely interacts with Go Core Banking over 'tirenn-net'. Forwards observations to in-memory scratchpad.
Token Telemetry & Interactive Action Card Emission
Stores token usage in Redis; renders Human-in-the-Loop OTP transfer card on React client.
